name: Outro
_source: *the party stands at the enterance to the temple
##needs rewrite for this line####Anael;The temple at last. It feels strange to be standing in front of something you were trying to destroy only a few hours ago.
Bramar;Ya think that's strange? What about that fire nation captain? He was too polite for his own damn good.
Anael;That was strange but not the other guard screaming his head off? Speaking of which, I wonder who was that traitor he was talking about. Must be particularly vile coming from the fire nation.
Nelad;...
Anael;Nelad, are you ok? You've been looking a little... distant.
Nelad;Oh. It's... not important right now.
Anael;But it still troubles you, doesn't it? I don't mind listening to your troubles, it's the least I can do.
------ Alt Dialogue ------
- If Nelad has defeated at least one unit:

Nelad;...I have never taken a life before, it doesn't come naturally to me. Pacifism has been my way of life for as long as I could remember, but I know better. To fend for myself, to survive, I need to take lives.|... And yet...
- If Nelad hasn't defeated any units:

Nelad;It's... I apologise for not being of more use. My inaction could've put you all in danger, but making a decision like that in the moment was... difficult.|Fighting is one thing... but to kill someone? It's unthinkable...
------- Reconverge -------
Anael;Nelad...
map_anim;Surprise;Anael (select 6 is the correct sfx for this animation i believe)
Anael;Watch out!!
*anael shoves nelad
*in between them with a "woosh" effect, folre appears.
Folre;Damn, missed.
map_anim;Surprise;Folre
Folre;Oh!|Thought you were someone else!|...No hard feelings, yeah?
Bramar;We'll see how you're feeling after I'm done with ya.
*Folere portrait backs up
Folre;Woah! Wait wait WAIT!!
*Nelad gets between them
Nelad;Hold on.|You aren't with the soldiers we just routed, are you?
Folre;Nope. Well, kinda. Those guys had it out for me. Thanks for getting them off my back, I appretiate it.
Anael;Why *were* they chasing you in the first place?
Folre;Oh, you know... something stupid. I wouldn't worry about it.|Hey mind if I come with you guys?
Anael;What??
Nelad;I don't see why not.
Anael;Y-you can't be serious..?

Nelad;He's by his lonesome and being hunted by his fellow soldiers, I don't see him betraying us anytime soon.|On top of that, we still have to stop whatever is left of that squadron still inside the temple. Trust me, I understand how you feel, but right now, we need all the help we can get.
Anael;.....|Fine. I'll put up with him for now.
Folre;Great! Glad to hear it! Names Folre, by the way. Hope we can get along!
Anael;...Right.
Nelad;Lets go. We have no time to lose.
*everyone enters the temple
--End of Chapter--
